duplicate_time.message: {day}: two slots at the same time

empty_schedule.message: The schedule cannot be completely empty

set_days.name: Set schedule for days
set_days.description: Replaces the slots of the selected days (other days stay the same). A backup is made before writing and the result is verified.

days.name: Days
days.description: all, workdays, weekend, mon…sun or 0–6 (0 = Sunday)

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: List of slots: [{"time": "06:00", "temp": 75}] or [{"time": "07:00", "showers": 2}]. Time = when the water should be ready.

set_schedule.name: Set the whole schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the whole weekly schedule. Days that are not listed get no slots.

restore_backup.name: Restore schedule from backup
restore_backup.description: Without a file name it restores the schedule as it was before the last change.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Read the schedule and the consumption from the Ariston server now.

export_xlsx.name: Create Excel report
export_xlsx.description: Creates an .xlsx file with consumption (kWh) and cost per tariff by month, day and hour. The link is in the "Excel report" sensor.
